description: Set the 2D overlay images: 'background' is drawn behind the whole scene, 'frame' on top of it. Values come from studio_list_overlays. Pass an empty string to clear one, omit a field to leave it untouched. These are flat images and do not replace the 3D map (studio_set_map). An unreadable image clears that overlay and reports an error. Returns both overlays as the scene now holds them.

background.description: 'path' of a background from studio_list_overlays, or "" to clear

frame.description: 'path' of a frame from studio_list_overlays, or "" to clear
